key_concepts: Volume is the amount of space matter occupies
Two objects cannot occupy the same space at the same time
Beakers and graduated cylinders are tools used to measure liquid volume
Liter and milliliter are units of volume
1 liter equals 1000 milliliters and 1000 cubic centimeters
Volume of a cube is length times width times height
Graduated cylinder readings use the lower meniscus at eye level
Water displacement can measure the volume of irregular solids
All matter, including liquids, solids, and gases, has volume
